definitions.explanation: Used as a modifier to indicate that an action, skill, or attitude is directed toward or involves other people. Almost always attached to another noun rather than standing alone.

examples.japanese: {対人|たいじん}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悩|なや}んでいる→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧。
examples.english: I'm troubled by my interpersonal relationships.

examples.japanese: {対人|たいじん}スキル⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It is important to polish your interpersonal skills.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自動車|じどうしゃ}{保険|ほけん}→自動車保険：26400_jidoushahoken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{対人|たいじん}⟦{賠償|ばいしょう}→賠償：07641_baishou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{対物|たいぶつ}⟦{賠償|ばいしょう}→賠償：07641_baishou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Car insurance includes both personal liability and property liability coverage.

notes:
Functions as a modifier prefix combining ⟦{対|たい}→対：03382_tai⟧ (toward, against) + ⟦{人|じん}→〜人：09849_jin⟧ (person). Always paired with a following noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {対人|たいじん}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: interpersonal relationships
- {対人|たいじん}スキル: interpersonal skills
- {対人|たいじん}⟦{恐怖症|きょうふしょう}→恐怖症：27678_kyoufushou⟧: social anxiety; fear of people
- {対人|たいじん}⟦{賠償|ばいしょう}→賠償：07641_baishou⟧: personal liability (insurance)
- {対人|たいじん}⟦{援助|えんじょ}→援助：01892_enjo⟧: helping/support work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {対物|たいぶつ}: toward objects — its counterpart, used especially in insurance
- ⟦{人間|にんげん}{関係|かんけい}→人間関係：11462_ningenkankei⟧: human relationships — more general; can replace {対人|たいじん}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧ in casual speech
